about:
Micro Metals, Inc. was founded in 1972 by Kenny Driscoll in Colorado Springs, Colorado, at an elevation of 6,272 feet. The family‑owned and operated company began as a precision sheet‑metal fabrication shop and has remained a single‑source manufacturer of custom metal products for over five decades.

Today the firm operates a 141,000‑square‑foot facility with a secured 208,000‑square‑foot outside storage yard. Its highly automated processes include three laser‑cutting systems, waterjet cutting, robotic and manual press brakes, robotic and manual welding, CNC machining (VMC, HMC, VTC), CNC punching, coil punching, rollforming, blanking, assembly, engineering support, and an in‑house powder‑ and liquid‑coating line that is CARC‑certified. The workforce is notable for its tenure: machinists average 15 years on the shop floor, and the engineering department includes several military veterans.

Micro Metals serves customers in telecommunications, U.S. military, energy, climate‑control, construction, and secure‑storage industries, shipping to local, national, and international clients from its central Rocky Mountain location.

The company emphasizes its “one‑stop” model—quoting, designing, manufacturing, assembling, and shipping under one roof—to control lead times and supply‑chain risk. A culture of continuous improvement, family values, and a commitment to Made‑in‑USA production underpin its reputation for speed, trust, and cost‑efficient manufacturing. Philanthropic efforts have also placed Micro Metals parts in humanitarian building projects on four continents.
